Rooted in Pune, supplying the world

Deva Exim INC is a Pune-based supplier, exporter, trader and distributor of Ayurvedic herbal powders and spice powders, started in 2023.

देव

Deva is Sanskrit for divine. Long before they were commodities, the herbs we trade were treated as gifts. We want them to reach you that way: clean, honest and as nature made them.

Our story

Deva Exim began in 2023 in Narhe, on the southern edge of Pune, with a simple aim: make it easy for buyers abroad to source authentic Indian herbs and spices from a partner who answers questions directly.

We keep a focused range of ten products so we can know each one well: how it should look and smell, which part of the plant it comes from, and what a good lot shows on a certificate of analysis.

Pune also makes shipping practical. JNPT (Nhava Sheva), one of India’s busiest container ports, is about 140 km away by expressway, and Mumbai’s air cargo terminal is a similar drive.

How we work

Specific, not vague

Every product page lists the botanical name, the part used, the HS code and the parameters we check. If we do not know something yet, we say so.

Samples before promises

We would rather you test our material than take our word for it. Ask for samples, then start with a trial order of 25 kg.

One contact, start to finish

You deal with the same person from quotation to delivery, by email, phone or WhatsApp.

Tell us what you need

Send the products, quantities and destination port. We reply within one working day with prices, lead time and freight options.
